The Company

At Comunet, we love great tech—but what really drives us is what it makes possible. For 30 years, we’ve been helping organisations get more from their IT, whether that means tightening security, modernising legacy environments, reducing complexity, or setting them up for what’s next. We work with smart people, solve real problems, and build technology that genuinely makes life easier for our clients.? 

We’re big on curiosity, initiative, and people who genuinely enjoy figuring things out. We like teammates who can dive into a technical challenge, collaborate well, share what they know, and still keep things light along the way. Culture matters here, and we invest in it—with a strong Employee Value Proposition, Friday drinks, team events, whole-of-business catchups, and a fully stocked pantry. We work hard, support each other, and make sure there’s room to grow, experiment, and enjoy the ride.? 

We invest in our people through certified and flexible training, flexible work options, and strong support structures. We also believe in promoting from within and take pride in seeing our people grow and succeed. 



About the Role

The Support Engineer role at Comunet is not an entry-level position—it’s for someone who already has solid runs on the board and enjoys getting stuck into complex technical problems. You’ll be a key escalation point within our support team, taking ownership of issues across networking, cloud, security, infrastructure, and more. We’re looking for someone who can work with confidence, think critically, and bring the kind of hands-on experience that helps solve the tougher challenges when they land. 

At its core, this role is about keeping client and internal environments secure, stable, and performing at a high standard—but it also comes with real responsibility. This is a role for someone who can operate with a fair degree of autonomy, make sound technical decisions, and contribute meaningfully across both BAU support and project work. You’ll also help guide graduate and entry-level team members, share your knowledge, and lift the capability of the wider team through experience, mentorship, and technical leadership. 

We operate 6am - 6pm Monday to Friday to service our clients and shifts will fall within these hours on a rotating basis. 

 Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia on an ongoing basis. 



Key Responsibilities:

Deliver high-quality IT support to our clients, with a strong focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and customer service. 

Provide guidance and mentoring to IT Support Analysts, interns, and other junior team members, helping build technical capability across the team. 

Manage support tickets effectively, ensuring client requests are accurately logged, updated, prioritised, and progressed through to resolution. 

Deliver remote and phone-based support for escalated and technology-specific issues across a broad range of client environments. 

Contribute to onsite support activities and assist with project delivery, technical implementations, and other assigned tasks as required. 

Maintain, patch, monitor, and upgrade IT environments to support reliability, performance, and security outcomes. 

Ensure work is tracked in timesheets for client services and personal development activities. 

Support and administer core IT infrastructure and cloud-based systems, applying strong technical skills across modern business environments. 



 Key technical skills:

Knowledge of basic networking (routing and switching). 

2+ years of experience in Windows Server Administration. This is expected to include familiarity with Active Directory, Group Policy, and management of common server roles. 

2+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration (with exposure to hybrid Exchange environments considered highly desirable). 

AWS and/or Azure skills highly desirable. 

Demonstrate a strong knowledge of security practises and controls. 



Attributes we look for:

You’ll bring at least two years of IT experience, along with relevant qualifications or certifications, and be ready to build on your existing knowledge. You’ll enjoy working with clients to solve technical challenges and help deliver stable, secure, and reliable platforms for their business. 



How to Apply

We'd love a cover letter with your CV addressing why you should be the suitable candidate to join us. 

As this is active ongoing recruitment process the position may be filled with the right applicant before the published closing date - so we encourage applications as early as possible.  

By submitting an application to Comunet, you acknowledge that we will undertake workforce screening activities including, but not limited to: Reference checks, National Crime and Right to Work Checks, Identity and certification verification.

Only candidates that are short listed will be contacted.

Your new company     
 Join a globally recognised engineering and industrial services organisation with a strong presence across Australia and a reputation for delivering high-performance solutions within the energy, mining, and heavy industrial sectors. 
   
 With a long history of innovation and technical excellence, the business specialises in compressor and rotating equipment services, supporting critical infrastructure for major clients. You'll be part of a company that values safety, reliability, and continuous improvement, backed by global expertise and local execution. 
   Your new role     
 As Service Manager, you will take full responsibility for leading the service division, driving operational performance, team capability, and customer satisfaction. 
   
 This is a key leadership role balancing people management, technical oversight, and commercial delivery, where you'll play a key role in ensuring service quality, profitability, and long-term client partnerships. 
   
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Leading and developing a team of field service technicians, workshop operators, and supervisors, ensuring high performance and engagement 
 Managing service operations end-to-end, including scheduling, resource allocation, and job execution 
 Overseeing maintenance, overhauls, and repairs of compressors and rotating equipment 
 Driving safety-first culture and ensuring compliance with all relevant standards and procedures 
 Building and maintaining strong relationships with key customers, acting as the escalation point when required 
 Identifying and delivering operational improvements to increase efficiency, utilisation, and service delivery outcomes 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 You're an experienced leader within industrial or technical service environments, known for your ability to drive performance, build capable teams, and deliver strong commercial outcomes. 
   
 You don't just manage operations, you lead with intent, think strategically, and continuously look for ways to improve service delivery, efficiency, and profitability. 
   
 You will bring: 
 
 Proven experience in a Service Manager or senior leadership role within industrial, mechanical, or engineering environments 
 Trade qualification in Fitting, Machining, or a related discipline 
 Strong working knowledge of service management systems, ERP platforms, and scheduling tools 
 Exposure to Oil & Gas or similar heavy industry sectors (highly regarded) 
 Solid technical expertise across compressors, rotating equipment, or comparable mechanical systems 
 Demonstrated leadership capability, with a track record of coaching, developing, and holding teams accountable 
 A strong commitment to safety, compliance, and quality standards 
 The ability to build trust and credibility with both internal stakeholders and external clients 
 Sound commercial acumen, with the ability to identify opportunities to improve performance, revenue, and service outcomes 
 Highly developed organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform under pressure in a fast-paced service environment 
 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to step into a critical leadership role within a globally backed organisation 
 Autonomy to shape and improve service operations 
 Competitive salary package with long-term career progression opportunities 
 Exposure to major industrial clients and technically complex equipment 
 A supportive but performance-driven culture focused on safety and excellence

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Bunbury Hospital

St John of God Bunbury Hospital is seeking a Food Service Supervisor to provide leadership and supervision within our kitchen team, ensuring the delivery of high-quality food products and exceptional service to patients, visitors, and other customers. This hands-on role is responsible for overseeing daily food service operations, maintaining food safety and quality standards, supporting and mentoring team members, and contributing to a positive patient experience. Working closely with the broader hospitality and clinical teams, the successful candidate will help ensure efficient, customer-focused service in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

We have multiple opportunities being offered on a Permanent Part-Time basis, working 72 hours per fortnight.

If you are a motivated leader with a passion for food services, customer care, and team development, we encourage you to apply and become part of our dedicated team at St John of God Bunbury Hospital.

The Position:

Supports the Executive Chef in developing a culture of service excellence, sustainable patient satisfaction and sustainable employee engagement.

Ensures caregivers complete assigned tasks in a timely manner and to quality and safety standards.

Completes performance development reviews of caregivers under supervision.

In liaison with the Hotel Services Administrative Officer (Rostering) manages caregiver rosters and annual leave calendars ensuring maintenance of effective service levels.

Supports the Executive Chef with effective recruitment, induction and ongoing training, including the preparation of training material and its delivery to Food Service Attendants.

Manages performance issues, escalates to Executive Chef, Hotel Services Manager and Workforce Lead as required.

Supports the Executive Chef and the Hotel Services Manager leading the catering team through change management as the kitchen and service models progress.

Interprets patient meal tray cards for meal service for patients and ensures appropriate meals for patients who have allergy and therapeutic diet meal choices and participates in the preparation, plating and delivery of meals and snacks as required.

Ensures that all relevant food safety, compliance documentation codes of practice and legislative requirements are consistently met and maintained correctly.

You will have previous experience supervising in a catering environment with the ability to assist in training programs and be able to plan staff rosters and leave. You will have the ability to prioritise tasks, make decisions and guide the team and have a commitment to ongoing education and professional development

To succeed you will have well-developed verbal, written and interpersonal skills, a sound knowledge of hygiene regulations and an awareness of correct manual handling procedures.

Above all, patient care will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Salary: $71,369 to $72,635 (pro rata for part time), plus 12% superannuation

Two permanent part time positions available

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave and well-being programs

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

If suitable applicants are identified advertisement may close prior to listed date and screening-interviews may commence throughout the advertising process. 

For enquiries contact Emma Stirling, Food Services Coordinator, on 0400 806 906.

Our commitment is to create a safe and nurturing environment for all children and vulnerable individuals in our care and proactively take steps to protect them from abuse, ensuring their safety and well-being.

result.description:
ICT Sales Representative

Philip Riley is looking for a ICT Sales Representative to join team.

The ICT Sales Representative will be responsible for Developing and converting sales opportunities into sales of computer hardware, software and ICT services. Your main tasks will include:

· Reporting to management on the sales made

· Preparing sales reports, and maintaining and submitting records of business expenses incurred

· Quoting and negotiating prices and credit terms, and completing contracts and recording orders

· Assessing the demand for the different ICT products offered by the business and reporting to management

· Assessing customers' needs and explaining the goods and services which meet their needs

· Resolving any issues a client has as quickly and efficiently as possible

· Following up with clients to ensure they are satisfied with the products and/or services

· Compiling lists of prospective client businesses using trade directories and other sources

· Acquiring and updating knowledge of employer's and competitors' goods and services, and market conditions

· Arranging delivery of goods, installation of equipment and the provision of services

· Reporting to sales management on sales made and the marketability of ICT goods and services

Successful applicants must have:

· 1 year of relevant experience in the area or similar area

· Passion to deliver a positive experience with a positive attitude

· Proactive, growth-oriented work ethic

· High level of accountability & professionalism

· Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Salary $87,500.00 - $107,500.00 + Superannuation

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

Job Type: Full-time
